item.title: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip Sets Benchmark for AI Inference
item.description: OpenAI’s Jalapeño inference chip delivers a Pareto‑optimal mix of throughput, power efficiency and latency, beating NVIDIA‑based systems on benchmarks.

item.title: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip Raises AI Inference Bar by Power
item.description: OpenAI unveiled the Jalapeño inference chip at Hot Chips, delivering higher throughput per kilowatt, lower latency and a hardware‑software design.

item.title: Infinity Raises $15M to Break Nvidia's AI Monopoly
item.description: Inference startup Infinity raises $15M to automate low_level code for AI chips, challenging Nvidia's CUDA dominance with its Ignition agent.
